meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Runs maximum-saturation research with a cooperating team, claim-graph gating, and a cited, QA'd deliverable. Use when the user explicitly asks for research or a deep investigation, including any 'ulw' research wording.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对指定主题做深度调研,产出带引用、经质检的结论报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要对某个主题做彻底调研,并需要可追溯的引用
copy.tagline_en: Run deep research on a topic and get a cited, vetted report
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need exhaustive research on a topic with traceable citations

howto.what: 它把调研变成团队作业:先拆题、组建协作团队、多路追查来源、成员之间互相辩论挑错,再用代码验证有争议的结论,最后交付每条说法都带引用或证明的合成报告。
howto.when: 只在你明确要求研究时才接管:说出 “ulw-research”(含带 /、$ 前缀)、任何 “ulw” 研究措辞,或明确要求深度调研、超精确调查(任意语言)。普通提问或调试不触发。

say.text: ulw-research,帮我调研一下这个话题
say.note: 会打印模式启用标记并开始调研

say.text: 用 ultradebate 深挖这个议题,争议点要正反辩论
say.note: 对有争议的结论发起辩论轮次

say.text: /ulw-research,研究完给我 PDF 和 DOCX
say.note: 组队前会先问你要什么格式

howto.what_en: It turns research into team work: scope the topic, stand up a cooperating team, fan out over sources, debate findings, verify contested claims with code, and deliver a synthesis where every claim carries a citation or proof.
howto.when_en: Takes over only when you explicitly ask for research: “ulw-research” (/ulw-research, $ulw-research), any “ulw” research wording, or an explicit deep-research request in any language.

say_en.text: ulw-research, investigate this topic for me
say_en.note: Prints the mode marker and starts the run

say_en.text: Use ultradebate to dig into this and argue both sides
say_en.note: Runs debate rounds on contested claims

say_en.text: /ulw-research, then give me PDF and DOCX
say_en.note: Asks the format gate before the team is built
